Description.Name: 孤独者
Description.Details:
你一路横冲直撞走过人生，只信得过唯一靠得住的枪——你自己的。
特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkReckless]  鲁莽]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBrave]  勇敢]]

OptionDescription:
作为贵族家族的继承人，你从小要什么有什么。而结果证明……你受不了那种被娇养的高贵生活。

最终，某个夜里你带着家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  黑杰克]]偷偷离开，出发去寻找属于自己的新生活。

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorPiloting]  驾驶]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  战术]]
BioDescription: In your youth, while others your age had myriad interests, you fought tooth and nail to justify your own existence. Life was tough, so you had to be tougher.
